Container.Name: Preludarr
Container.Overview:
Theme songs for your media library. Preludarr finds the opening or theme song of each anime, TV show and movie and saves it as theme.mp3 in the title's folder, where Plex, Jellyfin and Emby play it.
First start: open the container log (Docker, Preludarr, Logs) for the one-time setup code, then open the web page and create your account.
Before an update, make a backup (System, Backup & Restore).
Container.Requires: Your TV and movie shares mapped read/write. Anime themes work out of the box; shows and movies use the free theme sources (Settings, Download Clients) and your own TMDB key.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: theme themes theme.mp3 anime opening plex jellyfin emby sonarr radarr
Container.Changes: ### 1.12.1 Sonarr/Radarr on Windows: path mappings accept Windows paths (G:\ => /mnt/media). ### 1.12.0 First stable release. Changes: https://github.com/shedman214/preludarr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Branch.TagDescription: Newest beta (or stable, whichever is newer). Make a backup before updating.

Config.Name: Config (appdata)
Config.Description: Database, settings, backups and logs. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: TV shows
Config.Description: Your TV and anime TV share. Read/write so Preludarr can save theme.mp3 in title folders. Add root folders inside it in Settings, Media Management.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Your movies and anime movies share. Read/write so Preludarr can save theme.mp3 in title folders.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User Preludarr runs as. 99 = nobody, the owner of Unraid shares.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions for new files (002 = group can write).

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional: your own TMDB API key (themoviedb.org, Settings, API) for posters and movie ids. Can also be set in Settings, Connect.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Optional: host names you open Preludarr by, e.g. preludarr.lan:8788. Private IP addresses always work.

Config.Name: Public HTTPS address
Config.Description: Optional: the HTTPS address when you use a reverse proxy or tunnel, e.g. https://preludarr.example.com

Config.Name: Background posters
Config.Description: Fetch missing posters in the background.

Config.Name: Manual installs
Config.Description: 1 = allow installing your own uploaded audio and YouTube links.

Config.Name: Update check
Config.Description: 0 = never check GitHub for new versions.
